paite: Huan lunglel lou a thum gige ding ahi chih atheihna ding un akiang uah gentehna agen hi.
heading: Thukhen Diktat Lou Gentehna
english: He also spoke a parable to them that they must always pray and not give up,

paite: "Koi lai khua hiam ah thukhenmi khat a-om a, huai mi'n Pathian alau kei a, mihing leng khawk asa kei hi.
english: saying, “There was a judge in a certain city who didn’t fear God and didn’t respect man.

paite: Huai khua ah meithai khat a-om a; ama'n, ka melma tung ah phu hon laksak in, chi in akiang ah ahoh zihzeh hi.
english: A widow was in that city, and she often came to him, saying, ‘Defend me from my adversary!’

paite: Huan amah sawt khop a-ut kei a; himahleh anung in alungsim in 'Pathian lau lou in mihing khawk sa kei mah leng;
english: He wouldn’t for a while; but afterward he said to himself, ‘Though I neither fear God nor respect man,

paite: hiai meithainu'n hon hihbuai ziak in aphu ka laksak mai ding, huchi lou in zaw, hong zihzeh taleh ahon hihbuai den kha ding, achi hi.
english: yet because this widow bothers me, I will defend her, or else she will wear me out by her continual coming.’”

paite: "Huan Toupa mah in, thukhen midiktat lou thugen za un.
english: The Lord said, “Listen to what the unrighteous judge says.

paite: 'Atung uah dohzou tadih mahleh leng amitel, asun-azan a amah samte phu Pathian in alaksak kei dia hia?'
english: Won’t God avenge his chosen ones who are crying out to him day and night, and yet he exercises patience with them?

paite: K'on hilh ahi, aphu uh alaksak pah ding. Himahleh Mihing Tapa ahong pai chiang in leitung ah huai bang ginna ahon mu diam?" achi hi.
english: I tell you that he will avenge them quickly. Nevertheless, when the Son of Man comes, will he find faith on the earth?”

paite: Huan midiktat hih kigingta a, midang tengteng musit kuate hiam kiang ah hiai gentehna leng agen hi.
heading: Pharisai Leh Siahkhonmi Thumna
english: He also spoke this parable to certain people who were convinced of their own righteousness, and who despised all others:

paite: "Tempul ah thum ding in mi nih ahohtou ua; khat Pharisai ahi a, khat siahkhonmi ahi.
english: “Two men went up into the temple to pray; one was a Pharisee, and the other was a tax collector.

paite: "Pharisai adingh a, amah kia in hichibang in athum hi: 'Pathian, midang negute, dikloute, angkawmte bang ka hih louh ziak leh hiai siahkhonmi bang leng ka hih louh ziak in na tung ah ka kipak hi.'
english: The Pharisee stood and prayed by himself like this: ‘God, I thank you that I am not like the rest of men: extortionists, unrighteous, adulterers, or even like this tax collector.

paite: Nipikal teng in nihvei an ka ngawl zel; ka neih teng sawm-a-khat ka pe zel," achi hi.
english: I fast twice a week. I give tithes of all that I get.’

paite: "Siahkhonmi'n bel gamlatak a dingh in, van lam leng adak ngam kei a, 'Pathian, kei mikhial, ka tung ah zahngai in,' chi in a-awm akitum hi.
english: But the tax collector, standing far away, wouldn’t even lift up his eyes to heaven, but beat his chest, saying, ‘God, be merciful to me, a sinner!’

paite: K'on hilh ahi, amasa sang in huai mi pen siamtang in a-inn ah apaikikta hi. Kingai thupi peuh aniam ding ua, kingainiam pahtawi in a-om ding," achi hi.
english: I tell you, this man went down to his house justified rather than the other; for everyone who exalts himself will be humbled, but he who humbles himself will be exalted.”

paite: Huan akhoih ding in akiang ah anaupang neute uh ahon pi ua; nungzuite'n huai amuhtak un ana tai uhi.
heading: Jesu'n Naupang Neute Avualzawl / (Mat 19.13-15; Mar 10.13-16)
english: They were also bringing their babies to him, that he might touch them. But when the disciples saw it, they rebuked them.

paite: Himahleh Jesu'n akiang ah amaute asam a, "Naupang neute ka kiang ah hon paisak unla, kham kei un, Pathian lalgam huchibang mite a ahi ngal a.
english: Jesus summoned them, saying, “Allow the little children to come to me, and don’t hinder them, for God’s Kingdom belongs to such as these.

paite: Chihtaktak in ka hon hilh ahi, kuapeuh Pathian lalgam naupang neu in akipahpih bang a kipahpih lou asung ah alut kei hial ding," achi hi.
english: Most certainly, I tell you, whoever doesn’t receive God’s Kingdom like a little child, he will in no way enter into it.”

paite: Vaihawmmi kuahiam in akiang ah, "Sinsakpa hoih, tangtawn hinna tanna ding in bang ka hih dia?" chi in adong hi.
heading: Hauhna In Lam Akhak / (Mat 19.16-30; Mar 10.17-31)
english: A certain ruler asked him, saying, “Good Teacher, what shall I do to inherit eternal life?”

paite: Jesu'n akiang ah, "Bangziak a hoih hon chi? Mi khat kia ngal lou kuamah hoih a-om kei, huai tuh Pathian ahi.
english: Jesus asked him, “Why do you call me good? No one is good, except one: God.

paite: Thupiakte: Ang kawm ke'n, Tual that ke'n, Gu ke'n, Hek ke'n, Na nu leh pa zahtak in, chihte, na thei vele," achi hi.
english: You know the commandments: ‘Don’t commit adultery,’ ‘Don’t murder,’ ‘Don’t steal,’ ‘Don’t give false testimony,’ ‘Honor your father and your mother.’”

paite: Ama'n, "Huai tengteng ka tuailai chil a kipan ka zui zel," achi hi.
english: He said, “I have observed all these things from my youth up.”

paite: Huan Jesu'n huai azaktak in akiang ah, "Tu in thil khat na sam lai; na neih tengteng zuak inla, gentheite kiang ah hawm in, huchi in van ah gou na nei ding; huan hong pai inla, hon zui in," achi hi.
english: When Jesus heard these things, he said to him, “You still lack one thing. Sell all that you have and distribute it to the poor. Then you will have treasure in heaven; then come, follow me.”

paite: Amah bel, huai thute azak in, ahauh mahmah ziak in alungkham mahmah hi.
english: But when he heard these things, he became very sad, for he was very rich.

paite: Huchi in Jesu'n amah a-en a, "Mihaute Pathian lalgam lut haksa hi na e!
english: Jesus, seeing that he became very sad, said, “How hard it is for those who have riches to enter into God’s Kingdom!

paite: Pathian lalgam a mihausa alut sang in phimbil a sangawngsau lutsuak abaihlamzaw,” achi hi.
english: For it is easier for a camel to enter in through a needle’s eye than for a rich man to enter into God’s Kingdom.”

paite: Huai thu zate'n, "Huchi ahih in kua hotdam in a-om thei dia?" achi uhi.
english: Those who heard it said, “Then who can be saved?”

paite: Ama'n, "Mihing hih vual louh Pathian hihtheih ahi,” achi hi.
english: But he said, “The things which are impossible with men are possible with God.”

paite: Peter in, "Ngai in, kou bangkim nusia in ka hon zui uh," achi hi.
english: Peter said, “Look, we have left everything and followed you.”

paite: Ama'n akiang uah, "Chihtaktak in ka hon hilh ahi, 'Kuapeuh Pathian lalgam ziak a, inn hiam, zi hiam, unaute hiam, nu le pa hiam, tate hiam paisan photphot,
english: He said to them, “Most certainly I tell you, there is no one who has left house, or wife, or brothers, or parents, or children, for God’s Kingdom’s sake,

paite: tu damsung mahmah in asang a tamzaw mu lou ding kuamah a-om kei, hun hong tung lai ding a tangtawn hinna toh,' " achi hi.
english: who will not receive many times more in this time, and in the world to come, eternal life.”

paite: Huan sawm-le-nihte akiang ah apituam a, akiang uah, "Ngai un, Jerusalem a hohtou ding i hi ua; zawlneite thugelh tengteng Mihing Tapa tung ah atung ding hi.
heading: Jesu'n Asihna Ding Agelkholh Athumveina / (Mat 20.17-19; Mar 10.17-31)
english: He took the twelve aside and said to them, “Behold, we are going up to Jerusalem, and all the things that are written through the prophets concerning the Son of Man will be completed.

paite: Zentelte kiang ah piak in a-om ding a, nuihza bawlna in azang ding uh, zumhuaitak in abawl ding ua, achilphih ding uhi.
english: For he will be delivered up to the Gentiles, will be mocked, treated shamefully, and spit on.

paite: Huan avo ding ua, athat ding uh; ni thum ni in athounawn ding," achi hi.
english: They will scourge and kill him. On the third day, he will rise again.”

paite: Huai thute atheisiam kei ua, athugen alak uah sel in a-om, bang gen ahia chih leng athei kei uh.
english: They understood none of these things. This saying was hidden from them, and they didn’t understand the things that were said.

paite: Huan hichi ahong hi a, Jeriko atun ding kuan in, mittaw kuahiam lam gei ah khutdoh in ana tu hi.
heading: Mittaw Hihdamna / (Mat 20.29-34; Mar 10.46-52)
english: As he came near Jericho, a certain blind man sat by the road, begging.

paite: Huai mi'n mipi paiging aza a, bangchi thu ahia chih adong hi.
english: Hearing a multitude going by, he asked what this meant.

paite: Amau, "Nazaret Jesu apai ahi," chih ahilh uhi. 38 Huchi in "Jesu, David Tapa, ka tung ah zahngai in," chi in akikou hi.
english: They told him that Jesus of Nazareth was passing by.

paite: Amasate'n dai ding in atai ua, himahleh, "David Tapa, ka tung ah zahngai in," chi in akikou nak semsem hi.
english: He cried out, “Jesus, you son of David, have mercy on me!”

paite: Huchi in Jesu adingh a, akiang a hon pi ding in thu apia hi.
english: Those who led the way rebuked him, that he should be quiet; but he cried out all the more, “You son of David, have mercy on me!”

paite: Huchi in Jesu adingh a, akiang a hon pi ding in thu apia hi.
english: Standing still, Jesus commanded him to be brought to him. When he had come near, he asked him,

paite: Akiang ahong tun in, "Na tung ah bangchi a ka hih ahia na deih?" achi a, ana dong hi. Ama'n, "Toupa, muh theih ka ut," achi hi.
english: “What do you want me to do?” He said, “Lord, that I may see again.”

paite: Jesu'n akiang ah, "Mutheita in, na ginna dampih na hi," achi hi.
english: Jesus said to him, “Receive your sight. Your faith has healed you.”

paite: Huan thakhat in amu thei pah a, Pathian phat kawm zel in amah azuita hi; huan mi tengteng in huai amuh un, Pathian aphat uhi.
english: Immediately he received his sight and followed him, glorifying God. All the people, when they saw it, praised God.
